# Trace Correlation Checklist: Trace Id on Plugin Failures

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for failure correlation and for the
exclusions the parent closed. This is not an implementation test.
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist` from the feature requirements.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned. Mark `[x]` only when the requirement
text satisfies the quality criterion.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirement text was reviewed. It does
not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the failure log required for every failed ordinary served call
  that stored a trace id, not only for validation failures?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the validation-text change limited to a validation failure,
  with other error text explicitly left alone?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec require both halves of the success line: the failure
  log and the validation text?
  [Completeness, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the web serving mode, a second trace header, a tracing
  toolkit, provider billing measurement, and message-contract changes each
  named as out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the author's one-time attachment, including the logging-guide
  sentence, specified rather than left as an implementation choice?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "valid trace id" defined with length, character set, and the
  all-zero rejection, rather than "a proper id"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "full method name" defined as the service plus the method, not
  the short method alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the validation sentence, and a suffix of one space plus
  `trace_id=<id>`, specified exactly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the failure-log message fixed as `rpc failed`, rather than
  "an error is logged"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "only the first header value" stated as a requirement, not
  only as an example? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do FR-006 and FR-007 agree on when the stored id is copied and
  when the author's id is kept?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the failure log always carry the stored call id, including
  when the validation failure keeps a different author id?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK013 Does FR-003 (empty id when generation fails) agree with FR-004
  (no failure log without a stored id)?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the Clarifications and the Out of Scope section name the same
  non-goals, with no later section reopening them?
  [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 Does SC-003 (zero `trace_id=` when the field is empty) match
  FR-008's unchanged sentence?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can a reviewer count failure logs per failed call against SC-001
  without choosing a log format beyond the specified fields?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-002 decidable for both an empty validation id and an
  author-supplied id? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-005 decidable by searching logs and validation text for a
  rejected header value? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 Is SC-006 decidable as an unchanged header set, an unchanged
  message contract, and zero new tracing-toolkit dependencies?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Are success criteria free of a language, a library, or a function
  name? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary, alternate, and exception flows specified for a valid
  header, a missing header, and an invalid header? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the success-path requirement the absence of a failure log, not
  an unspecified "happy path"? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Is a non-validation failure specified as logged with the stored id
  and not given a text suffix? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the no-id author-log case specified, not only the case where an
  id exists? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are uppercase hex, wrong length, non-hex characters, and all zeros
  all classified as invalid? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is generation failure specified as continuing the call with no id,
  rather than failing the call? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a missing full method name specified as an empty method name
  on a log that still carries the trace id? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is a validation failure nested in another failure specified,
  including when the outer text does not include the inner sentence?
  [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Is a logger that drops error-level records distinguished from a
  failed stamp? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Is a second attachment of the same field specified as a duplicate
  the guide forbids, not as a merge? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Does the spec keep the success path free of a new failure record,
  so performance scope is the failure path only?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Is a new benchmark intentionally not required, with that limit
  written down rather than omitted? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Are rejected header values excluded from logs and validation text
  so the injection bound stays intact?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Is the existing header name recorded as an assumption, so a later
  edit does not invent a second key? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the web serving mode's exclusion tied to the earlier
  usage-stats and allocation decisions, rather than left as an unexplained
  gap? [Dependency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the spec state that shipped tests lock the scenarios and that
  this design does not ask for a new suite? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the logging guide identified so FR-009 has a single document to
  satisfy? [Dependency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK038 Is any requirement still marked as needing clarification, or do
  the session answers replace every open assessment question?
  [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK039 Does any requirement ask to keep an invalid host value while
  another requires replacement? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK040 Does any in-scope requirement ask for a message-contract field
  while FR-011 forbids one? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011]
